taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: Drawn as a forb: a trailing perennial with slender, often rooting stems (Abrams 1951 p. 646), which the herb program draws as many low, outward-leaning stems.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a trailing mat 3 cm to 10 cm high; the stems trail along the ground, drawn as short stems leaning out, as the herb program cannot lay a stem down.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii (now Clinopodium douglasii): a trailing perennial with slender stems.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: a trailing aromatic perennial.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: leaves evergreen.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: leaves along the trailing stems.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Opposite, as in the family (Abrams 1951) and the photos: the species account does not say.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: leaves ovate, 15 mm to 25 mm long.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: petioles 3 mm to 8 mm long, from the photos; Abrams (1951 p. 646) names them without a length.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: leaves ovate, obtuse to subcordate at base, obtuse at apex.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: rather shallowly crenate or crenate-serrate.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: glabrous above.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: glandular-dotted and sparsely puberulent especially on the veins beneath.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: flowers solitary in the axils.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: pedicels slender, mostly 10 mm to 15 mm long.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: a small two-lipped tube, 6 mm to 8 mm long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: corolla 6 mm to 8 mm long.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: corolla white or more or less tinged with purple; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: Four nutlets, as in the family (Abrams 1951): the species account does not describe its fruit.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 646, Satureja douglasii: flowering April to October.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: slender reddish-green trailing stems; bright, slightly yellowish green oval leaves with scalloped edges, in pairs; small white flowers on slender stalks from the leaf axils.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for yerba buena from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite: the herb program's structure (stems, nodes, basal leaves, how the flowers are borne). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.075 m tall at 3 years in the open, within the flora's range. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
